answer.text:
Intel Foundry external revenue fell **about 59.6%**, or **60%**, in 2024 versus 2023:

\[
\frac{\$953\text{ million}-\$385\text{ million}}{\$953\text{ million}}\times100
=\frac{\$568\text{ million}}{\$953\text{ million}}\times100
\approx59.6\%.
\]

The filing attributes the decline primarily to **lower traditional packaging services revenue and lower equipment sales**. (Accession **0000050863-25-000009**, *Filing Summary*, chunk **12**.)
